sloka: विनेदुश्च महानादान् सर्वतो जलदोपमाः ।हतो राम इति ज्ञात्वा रावणिं समपूजयन् ।। ६.४६.२७ ।।।।
transliteration: vineduśca mahānādān sarvato jaladopamāḥ ।hato rāma iti jñātvā rāvaṇiṁ samapūjayan ।। 6.46.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter having seen the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana not responding or breathing, lying on the ground, he thought they were dead.
